# Compliance Check - Internal Control and AML

This document details critical tasks for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Investigate internal control based on audit findings.
*   Conduct quarterly investigations of internal control.
*   Optimize legal risks standard updates.
*   Update AML detection based on audit findings.
*   Monitor AML detection quarterly.
